response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT ci.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits ci ON ci.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY ci.country), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall FROM c), a AS (SELECT c.country, c.avg_wins FROM c, o WHERE c.avg_wins > o.overall), g AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS grp FROM a) SELECT AVG(a.avg_wins) AS mean_avg_wins, AVG(a.avg_wins - o.overall) AS mean_excess_over_overall, AVG(a.avg_wins - g.grp) AS mean_excess_over_group FROM a, o, g WHERE a.avg_wins > g.grp
